description: This file defines functions and types for checking and collecting issues related to BlueBubbles accounts, including status and probe results, and exports a function to collect status issues for accounts.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts a value to a non-empty string or null.

methods.name: readBlueBubblesAccountStatus
methods.description: Reads and maps a ChannelAccountSnapshot to BlueBubblesAccountStatus.

methods.name: readBlueBubblesProbeResult
methods.description: Reads and maps a value to BlueBubblesProbeResult.

methods.name: collectBlueBubblesStatusIssues
methods.description: Main exported function that collects issues for BlueBubbles accounts.
